title: Decision: turn the Claude agent review back on beside Codex, and which fleet extras to opt into
body:
Key `WP-REVIEW-DECISION`

**Context**
Waypoint's independent review is off: `.github/workflows/agent-review.yml` has its `pull_request_target` trigger commented out ("Codex reviews pull requests now"), `.github/scripts/merge-gate.sh` sets `REQUIRED_STATUSES=()`, and `AGENTS.md` ("Mistakes that keep coming back", "Git and PRs") tells agents to watch `chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]`'s comments. Codex's comments don't gate a merge: nothing in the merge gate reads them. fleet v1 adds a Fable second review for risky pull requests and a monthly report of repeated review findings, both built on the agent-review pipeline. `WP-FLEET-WORKFLOWS` follows whatever is decided here.

**Scope**
Answer each item in a comment:

1. **First review.** (a) Recommended: turn the Sonnet "Agent review" back on as a required status (fleet's reusable workflow); Codex keeps commenting if you want it. (b) Keep it off: fleet's `first-review: false`, so only "Second review" runs, and only on risky pull requests; the monthly mining then sees only those.
2. **Second review paths.** Accept the list in `WP-FLEET-WORKFLOWS` or edit it here.
3. **Screenshot diff.** Opt into fleet's screenshot-diff report for `docs/src/assets/screenshots/` (it comments on UI PRs with a link to a before/after report; never a verdict). Default: yes.
4. **Secrets.** Confirm `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` is still set in the repository (the development docs say it's needed when the review is turned back on), and that `FLEET_BOT_APP_ID`/`FLEET_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY` are set (`FLEET-SETUP`).
5. **Labels.** Create `safety-critical`, `fleet` and `review-mining` (`security` and `manual` already exist).

**Out of scope**
Changing `CLAUDE.md`'s model routing (it stays as it is).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Items 1–5 answered here.

**Tests**
None (decision).

**Depends on**
Nothing.

**Model**
Owner (no coding model).

title: ci: adopt fleet v1 workflows (agent review with the Fable second review, merge gate, security scans, control smoke, mining, sync)
body:
Key `WP-FLEET-WORKFLOWS`

**Context**
Waypoint carries its own copies of what fleet now provides: `.github/workflows/agent-review.yml`, `.github/scripts/agent_review.py`, `.github/scripts/agent-review-run.sh`, `.github/agent-review/` (prompt, schema, incremental, package files), `.github/workflows/merge-gate.yml` + `.github/scripts/merge-gate.sh`, `.github/workflows/security.yml`, `control-smoke.yml`, `cancel-on-close.yml`, `tidy-releases.yml`. This issue replaces them with callers of fleet's reusable workflows, pinned by SHA, following {{WP-REVIEW-DECISION}}. Waypoint releases on every push to `main`, so this lands as one PR titled `ci: …` (a patch release).

This PR changes `.github/workflows/agent-review.yml`, but `pull_request_target` runs main's copy, so the new review first runs on the next PR; the owner reviews this one by hand (CODEOWNERS already covers `.github/`).

**Scope**
- `.github/workflows/agent-review.yml` → a caller: `pull_request_target` on `main` with `[opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, labeled, unlabeled]`; `permissions: {}` at the top and the called jobs' permissions on the job; secrets `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` passed by name; `generated`: `docs/openapi.json`, `frontend/src/lib/api-types.ts`, `docs/feature-map.json`, `docs/src/content/docs/contributing/feature-map.md`; `first-review` per the decision; `second-review-paths` below.
- Second-review paths (`.github/**` and `.claude/**` are built in): `waypoint/oidc.py`, `waypoint/tls.py`, `waypoint/storage/secretbox.py`, `waypoint/storage/stored_mail.py`, `waypoint/storage/gate_codes.py`, `waypoint/storage/backup.py`, `waypoint/domain/visibility.py`, `waypoint/domain/trippeople.py`, `waypoint/domain/loyalty.py`, `waypoint/domain/offline.py`, `waypoint/domain/mail/scan.py`, `waypoint/domain/mail/extract.py`, `waypoint/domain/mail/safe_html.py`, `waypoint/domain/mail/ai.py`, `waypoint/domain/mail/autoask.py`, `waypoint/providers/gmail.py`, `waypoint/providers/mailimages.py`, `waypoint/server/handler.py`, `waypoint/server/routes.py`, `waypoint/server/mcp_*.py`, `waypoint/server/oauth_http.py`, `waypoint/server/api/mailboxes.py`, `waypoint/server/api/offline.py`, `waypoint/server/api/assistant.py`, `waypoint/server/api/backups.py`, `frontend/src/lib/email-render.ts`, `frontend/src/lib/offline*.ts`, `frontend/src/lib/api.ts`, `.semgrep/**`, `SECURITY.md`, and the photos epic's files as they appear: `waypoint/providers/immich.py`, `waypoint/storage/photo_sources.py`, `waypoint/server/api/photos.py`, `waypoint/domain/photos.py`. PHOTOS-SOURCES, PHOTOS-API and PHOTOS-PROXY are labelled `security`, so they get the second review whatever files they touch.
- `.github/agent-review/context.md` (new): what Waypoint is and what private data looks like in it (travellers' names, confirmation codes and record locators, loyalty and Known Traveler numbers, itineraries with dates, email text and addresses); fixtures are made-up emails; demo data lives in `waypoint/domain/demo.py`.
- `.github/agent-review/invariants.md` (new): Waypoint's promises from `AGENTS.md` ("Email stays on the server", "You see the trips you're on", "IDs are for the household", "Times are where they happen") as numbered invariants, each with the checks the promise already names (`waypoint-trip-visibility`, `tests/test_every_route.py`, `tests/privacy.py`'s `no_leaks`, `tests/test_hostile_markup.py`, `tests/test_offline.py` and the rest); PHOTOS-PROXY adds "Photos stay in Immich" here when it adds it to `AGENTS.md`.
- Delete `.github/scripts/agent_review.py`, `.github/scripts/agent-review-run.sh`, `.github/agent-review/{prompt.md,schema.json,incremental.md,package.json,package-lock.json}`, `.github/scripts/merge-gate.sh`, `tests/test_agent_review.py` (it moved to fleet), and the agent-review npm entry in `.github/dependabot.yml` if present.
- `.github/workflows/merge-gate.yml` → a caller: keeps its triggers (`workflow_run` of `Docker image`, `Security scans`, `Docs`, `Control smoke`; `check_suite`; `workflow_dispatch` with `pr`) and job `if:`; `required-workflows`: `Docker image`, `Security scans`, `CodeQL`; `required-statuses`: `Agent review` and `Second review` (decision 1a) or `Second review` alone (1b).
- `.github/workflows/security.yml` → a caller: `code-paths` `^(waypoint|frontend/src|\.semgrep)/`, `web-dirs` `frontend`, `image-paths` `^(Dockerfile|\.dockerignore|pyproject\.toml|poetry\.lock)$`, `runs-on` with today's `vars.RUNS_ON` expression, the weekly `cron: "17 5 * * 1"` kept in the caller.
- `control-smoke.yml` → a caller of fleet's `verify.yml` (`make-target: control-smoke`, same `paths:`, job still named "Control smoke"); `cancel-on-close.yml` and `tidy-releases.yml` → callers; screenshot-diff caller (`dir: docs/src/assets/screenshots/`) if decision 3 says yes.
- New callers: `review-mining.yml` (monthly), `deep-scan-due.yml` (quarterly, `cron: "17 7 2 1,4,7,10 *"`), `fleet-sync.yml` (push to `main` on `.github/workflows/**`, weekly, by hand; `FLEET_BOT_APP_ID` variable and `FLEET_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY` secret by name).
- `.github/dependabot.yml`: the github-actions entry gains the `fleet` group (`AnthonyPluth/fleet/*`).
- `docs/src/content/docs/contributing/development.md`: replace the "Agent review … is disabled" paragraph with how the reviews run now (both statuses, secrets, budgets as repository variables, and fleet's docs link).

**Out of scope**
`AGENTS.md`, `tools/`, `.claude/`, `Makefile` and `docker.yml`'s fleet-checks job (`WP-FLEET-CONTENT`). `CLAUDE.md` stays as it is.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] No copy of fleet's scripts or prompts remains (`git grep -n "agent_review.py\|merge-gate.sh"` finds only docs that point at fleet).
- [ ] Every `AnthonyPluth/fleet/` reference is pinned by SHA with a `# v1.x.y` comment, all at one version; `make fleet-checks` (today's checks) and zizmor pass.
- [ ] After merge, a throwaway PR by an agent that touches `waypoint/oidc.py` gets "Agent review" (if 1a), "Second review" (risky by path) and "Merge gate" statuses; adding the `security` label to another throwaway PR reruns only the second review. Links pasted here; the owner closes both PRs.
- [ ] The next weekly `Security scans` run on `main` is green, and `review-mining` run by hand creates the "Repeated review findings" issue.

**Tests**
`make fleet-checks`, `zizmor .github/workflows`, the throwaway PRs above.

**Depends on**
{{WP-REVIEW-DECISION}}; `AnthonyPluth/fleet` v1.0.0 (fleet issue `FLEET-RELEASE`); `FLEET-SETUP` done (App installed, secrets set).

**Model**
Fable (`claude-fable-5-1`): review workflows, CI secrets and untrusted pull request content.

title: chore: adopt fleet v1 content (shared tools, vendored skills and hook, AGENTS.md shared sections with the repeated-mistake rule)
body:
Key `WP-FLEET-CONTENT`

**Context**
After {{WP-FLEET-WORKFLOWS}}, Waypoint still carries `tools/fleet_checks.py`, `tools/no_comments.py`, `tools/coverage_floor.py`, `tools/test_timings.py`, `.github/scripts/next-version.sh` and `.claude/hooks/session-start.sh`, and its `AGENTS.md` repeats sections fleet now owns. Cloud sessions don't install plugins a repository declares, so fleet's skills, reviewer agent and hook arrive as vendored files written by `tools/fleet sync` and checked by `tools/fleet drift`.

**Scope**
- `pyproject.toml` gains `[tool.fleet]` with Waypoint's values (`docs/adopting.md` in fleet lists the keys): migrations `waypoint/storage/migrations/versions`, migration tests `tests/test_migrations.py`, tested-from `0001`, image homes `docs/public/`, `waypoint/static/`, `waypoint/storage/logos/`, image file `docs/src/assets/logo.png`, screenshots `docs/src/assets/screenshots/` named from `PAGES` in `frontend/verify/verify.mjs`, skills `.claude/skills`, the generated `verify-waypoint` references (`references/cli.md` and `references/feature-map.md`, with the commands `make verify-skill` and `make user-feature-map` use), no-comments over `waypoint`, `tests`, `tools` and `frontend/src`, coverage 85% overall and 90% per module in `waypoint/domain/`, `waypoint/providers/`, `waypoint/server/api/`, and `extra-checks = "tools.app_checks:CHECKS"`.
- `tools/app_checks.py` (new): the mail parser fixture check moved out of `tools/fleet_checks.py` (each vendor parser in `waypoint/domain/mail/parsers/` has `booking`, `change` and `cancellation` fixtures in `tests/fixtures/mail/`), with `tests/test_app_checks.py`.
- Delete `tools/fleet_checks.py`, `tools/no_comments.py`, `tools/coverage_floor.py`, `tools/test_timings.py`, `.github/scripts/next-version.sh` and their tests (`tests/test_fleet_checks.py`, `tests/test_no_comments.py`, `tests/test_coverage_floor.py`); they live in fleet.
- `Makefile`: `fleet-checks` → `tools/fleet checks --commits origin/main..HEAD` then `tools/fleet drift`; the coverage floor through `tools/fleet coverage-floor`; `test-timings` through `tools/fleet test-timings`; a `fleet-sync` target (`tools/fleet sync --to $(version)`).
- `.github/workflows/docker.yml`: the `fleet-checks` job becomes a caller of fleet's `checks.yml`; the coverage-floor step runs `tools/fleet coverage-floor coverage.json`; the release step's version comes from `tools/fleet next-version`.
- `tools/fleet sync --to v1.x.y` (the version the workflow pins carry): writes `.fleet/version`, `tools/fleet`, `.claude/skills/fleet-*`, `.claude/agents/fleet-reviewer.md`, `.claude/hooks/fleet-session-start.sh` and the AGENTS.md blocks.
- `.claude/hooks/fleet.conf`: `PYTHON_VERSION=3.14`, `FRONTEND_DIRS="frontend"`, `APT_PACKAGES="libfaketime"`. `.claude/settings.json`: SessionStart → `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/fleet-session-start.sh`; `extraKnownMarketplaces.fleet` pinned to the same tag; no `enabledPlugins` entry (fleet's `docs/adopting.md` says why). Delete `.claude/hooks/session-start.sh`. `.claude/skills/verify-waypoint/` stays.
- `AGENTS.md`: the fleet blocks for "Starting work", "Working in a container", "Mistakes that keep coming back" and "Git and PRs". Outside them, Waypoint keeps: the "Some checks only run in CI" bullet (updated: the agent review per {{WP-REVIEW-DECISION}}, Codex only if kept), its own mistakes after the block (Tests that share the database, Private data in logs, Personal data in the repo, Visibility, Time zones, each with its parenthesis), its screenshot bullet in "Git and PRs", and every other section ("Waypoint's promises" included). Remove the sentences that say the independent review is disabled if decision 1 is (a); `tools/` in "Layout" names `tools/fleet` and `tools/app_checks.py`.
- PHOTOS-PROXY also edits `AGENTS.md` (only "Waypoint's promises"); whichever PR lands second merges `main` and re-runs `make check`.

**Out of scope**
`CLAUDE.md` (routing unchanged); `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/agent-task.md` (Waypoint's own); `verify-waypoint` and `tools/control`.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] `make check` passes; `tools/fleet drift` is clean.
- [ ] Editing one character inside a fleet block, or in a vendored skill, fails `make fleet-checks` (shown in the PR, then reverted).
- [ ] A fresh cloud session in Waypoint runs `.claude/hooks/fleet-session-start.sh` and then `make check` with no manual setup (paste the hook's output).
- [ ] `claude doctor` in a local session reports no rejected entry in `.claude/settings.json`.
- [ ] The `AGENTS.md` diff outside the blocks only removes text the blocks now carry, the Codex lines per the decision, and the `tools/` layout line.

**Tests**
`tests/test_app_checks.py`, `make check`, `tools/fleet drift`.

**Depends on**
{{WP-FLEET-WORKFLOWS}}; `AnthonyPluth/fleet` v1.0.0 (fleet issue `FLEET-RELEASE`).

**Model**
Opus: moves tools and instructions; no secrets or review workflows.

title: Owner runbook: deep security scans with claude-security (first run, then quarterly)
body:
Key `WP-DEEP-SCAN`

**Context**
A deep scan with the claude-security plugin can't run in a workflow: the plugin asks a cost confirmation that only the person's own request can answer, refuses in a non-interactive session, and needs a live session (fleet's `docs/deep-scan.md`). fleet's `deep-scan-due` workflow, scheduled quarterly by {{WP-FLEET-WORKFLOWS}}, opens a "Deep security scan due" issue as the reminder. Waypoint is public, so findings never go into a public issue.

**Scope**
- Follow fleet's `docs/deep-scan.md`: a local session in a fresh clone of `main`, `/model claude-fable-5-1`, plugin from `claude-plugins-official`, "scan the whole repository at high effort" with your own sentence accepting the time and token cost.
- When: once after {{WP-FLEET-WORKFLOWS}} lands; again after the photos epic's security issues (PHOTOS-SOURCES, PHOTOS-API, PHOTOS-PROXY) merge; then each time a "Deep security scan due" issue opens.
- Findings: one draft security advisory per confirmed finding (Security → Advisories → New draft), never a public issue or PR text that describes the exploit; fixes go through the advisory's private fork, or a PR with a neutral title labelled `security` (so it gets the second review) once you decide disclosure doesn't matter.
- Record here only: the revision stamp's file name, the effort, and counts by severity. Nothing else from the report.

**Out of scope**
Fixing findings (each its own advisory or issue).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] First scan run; stamp, effort and counts recorded here.
- [ ] Every HIGH or CRITICAL finding has a draft advisory.
- [ ] The report directory was not committed (`git status` clean after the scan).

**Tests**
None (runbook).

**Depends on**
{{WP-FLEET-WORKFLOWS}}.

**Model**
Owner (no coding model); the scan itself runs on Fable 5.1.
